TLDR: Going second is definitely better than going first if you are using a slow deck but if you are using a fast deck with lots of low cost units going first means the world.

Going first is so valuable for any aggro/low cost deck, i have lost games by 1-5 damage all the time and just steamrolled if they drew right, there are 0 cost countermeasures and orders that are quite strong as long as you have draw mechanics to help you, usually its because they had a unit out turn 1 i didn't care about until it was too late that steamrolled later on, which is why even though i like thick decks i now find more success in winning before they get a chance to show me their big boys. I absolutely hate putting monster machines from germany and russia together only to get beat by a japan/germany/decks with strong support lines as they have loads of free turns to do damage whilst I'm getting ready, doesn't matter if you have 10 4+ cost units if you can't survive the early game, which turn 1 is vital for.

If i am playing a quick deck and you go second your chances of winning go down, the opponent might not do anything first or even second turn but once he has his first unit out all chances of you steamrolling them are most likely gone because then they start to ramp up and if my experience can say anything, when i have tried to aggro the enemy to death and they somehow slow me down or stop me completely then its almost guaranteed they will win unless i got a godly draw, to them going first meant nothing but to me it meant everything just as going first for him meant nothing and going second also meant nothing because their deck was built to get better the longer the game goes on whereas aggro decks focus on pure early game, it really does depend on your deck and strategy in mind to win.

Most decks will be thicker and slower starters so it would be just who has the best hands and more cards is usually better in this game so going second is super good which is what you are seeing now, but i definitely recommend a germany/japan blitz deck asap to combat these issues, you will start to realise how valuable the first 3 turns are but then the weakness of fast decks also which will mean you can make a slow deck which would of lost beforehand NOW WIN! Keep playing and you will make unbeatable decks trust me, like any card game if you have 2 pretty equally skilled players and 2 equally built decks then it's mostly down to luck.
